name: Dual Marching Cubes with Adaptive Octree and QEF Feature Isolation
definition: A surface extraction method that uses an adaptive octree to subdivide space based on a QEF (Quadratic Error Function) threshold, and extracts the isosurface using a dual marching cubes algorithm on the leaf nodes.
summary: Dual Marching Cubes with Adaptive Octree and QEF Feature Isolation extracts isosurfaces using an adaptive octree and QEF thresholds instead of a fixed grid.
